title: Slushie Bar Salts Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Salts' Menthol is a timeless flavour for those who appreciate uncomplicated classics. This e-liquid offers a straightforward yet profoundly satisfying menthol experience, reminiscent of the crisp, invigorating air of a frosty winter morning. Each inhale delivers a clean and sharp menthol sensation, providing a refreshing escape that clears the mind and invigorates the senses. The coolness of the menthol is perfectly balanced, ensuring a vape experience that is both smooth and exhilarating. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
